head_coach.name: Amir Ghalenoei
head_coach.play_style_summary: Blends structural defensive stability with rapid transition play. He primarily favors a compact 4-2-3-1 system, but exhibits tactical flexibility by employing a defensive 3-6-1 against stronger opponents or a direct 4-4-2 depending on match dynamics.

key_players.name: Mehdi Ghayedi
key_players.performance_stats: Playing for Al-Nasr SC (UAE) [1.2.3], he is a highly dynamic attacker who recently marked his return to the national team with a spectacular goal against Costa Rica in March.

key_players.name: Mehdi Taremi
key_players.performance_stats: The team's main attacking talisman who plays for Olympiakos. Highly experienced with over 100 caps, he excels at stretching opposition lines and contributing to defensive pressing.

key_players.name: Mohammad Mohebi
key_players.performance_stats: A consistent and highly physical winger playing for FC Rostov. He is a core tactical outlet for width and transition play in Ghalenoei's attacking setup.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Suffered a torn anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) in his left knee while playing for Polish club Lech Poznan in May 2026, ruling him out of the World Cup [2.1.3].
Omitted from the squad following a major political controversy and disciplinary storm regarding an Instagram post with the ruler of the UAE, alongside minor fitness concerns.
